remarks: Charming Brick Townhouse in a Convenient In-Town Location.   This spacious three-bedroom brick townhouse offering the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and easy living. Ideally situated close to the heart of New Canaan, this inviting home features hardwood floors and a bright, spacious living room with a fireplace and access to a private terrace-perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  The large eat-in kitchen offers plenty of room for everyday dining, while three generously sized bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. With 2 full baths and 1 half bath, the home offers a comfortable and functional layout.  A full unfinished basement provides excellent storage and offers wonderful potential for additional finished living space. Just across the street, enjoy a charming community park and play area, adding to the neighborhood feel of this special location.  Spacious, bright, and ideally located-an exceptional opportunity to enjoy in-town New Canaan living.
